newsitem.title: FINLAND: PROTOS SEES FAST GROWTH CREATING YIELD PRESSURES.
newsitem.headline: PROTOS SEES FAST GROWTH CREATING YIELD PRESSURES.

text.p: Robust economic activity in Europe -- and not necessarily doubts about monetary union -- may be putting pressure on bond yields in Europe, Finnish brokerage Protos said in a report received on Tuesday.
"Long yields could be under pressure in Europe due to the fact that markets have not priced in an acceleration of this robust economic activity," Protos said.
Last week's bond sell-off, which sharply raised Finnish long-term yields along with yields around Europe was mainly due to stronger than expected global growth, Protos said.
"We want to stress that we do not believe that the latest turbulence in the bond markets has been due to an increase in EMU uncertainty," it said.
"The very serious considerations of a possible EMU delay will start, at the earliest, after this summer," it said.
If the U.S. Federal Reserve moves on rates at its Tuesday FOMC meeting, Germany is liking to follow suit and Finnish interest rates would follow in the same direction, Protos said.
